title: Axsome Therapeutics to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 10
author: Na
description: Axsome Therapeutics announced it will report Q2 2026 financial results on August 10, 2026, followed by a management conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET. The company is advancing its CNS disorder treatment portfolio with FDA-approved products including SUNOSI, AUVELITY, and SYMBRAVO, while progressing multiple clinical trials including Phase 3 FOCUS-2 and FOCUS-3 trials for solriamfetol in pediatric and adolescent ADHD patients.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is expanding its clinical pipeline with initiation of Phase 3 trials (FOCUS-2 and FOCUS-3) for solriamfetol in pediatric and adolescent ADHD populations, demonstrating pipeline advancement and growth potential. The company maintains an established portfolio of FDA-approved CNS treatments and is actively progressing development programs, indicating positive momentum in both commercial and R&D operations.

title: These 3 Stocks Trounced the S&P 500 in the First Half of 2026 -- and Wall Street Thinks 1 of Them Could Soar Even More
author: Adria Cimino
description: Three biotech companies—Moderna, Revolution Medicines, and Axsome Therapeutics—significantly outperformed the S&P 500 in the first half of 2026 with double- and triple-digit gains. While Moderna faces expected pullback despite flu vaccine approval prospects, and Revolution Medicines shows modest upside, Wall Street expects Axsome to climb another 13% due to recent drug approvals and strong pipeline progress.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite strong first-half performance and upcoming flu vaccine approval (decision date Aug. 5), Wall Street expects a ~40% decline over the next 12 months, suggesting the stock has overextended relative to fundamentals.

Reported strong phase 3 results for pancreatic cancer drug (daraxonrasib) with unprecedented survival rates, positioning it as a potential game-changer. However, modest 2% upside forecast limits enthusiasm.

title: Is Axsome Therapeutics Stock a Millionaire Maker? Here's What the Numbers Say.
author: Adria Cimino
description: Axsome Therapeutics has experienced significant growth with its CNS disorder treatments, including recently approved drugs Auvelity for Alzheimer's agitation and Symbravo for migraines. While the stock has climbed 220% over three years and has strong revenue growth, the article cautions that reaching millionaire status from a single stock investment is unrealistic, recommending instead a diversified portfolio approach.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company demonstrates strong commercial momentum with Auvelity revenue up 59% and Sunosi up 34% in recent quarter. Multiple recently approved drugs (Auvelity for Alzheimer's, Symbravo for migraine) and robust late-stage pipeline (AXS-12, solriamfetol, AXS-14) position the company for continued growth. Stock has appreciated 220% over three years and maintains healthy cash position of $305 million.

title: Axsome Therapeutics Initiates FOCUS-3 Phase 3 Trial of Solriamfetol in Adolescents with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
author: Axsome Therapeutics
description: Axsome Therapeutics announced the initiation of the FOCUS-3 Phase 3 trial evaluating solriamfetol for treating ADHD in adolescents aged 12-17. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial will enroll approximately 468 patients across multiple centers over 6 weeks, with the primary endpoint measuring changes in ADHD Rating Scale scores.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is advancing its clinical pipeline with the initiation of a Phase 3 trial for solriamfetol in a new patient population (adolescents with ADHD), demonstrating progress in drug development and expansion of therapeutic indications. This represents a significant milestone in the company's growth strategy and potential market expansion.

title: Hypercharge Announces Issuance of Equity Grants
author: Hypercharge Networks Corp.
description: Hypercharge Networks Corp. announced the grant of 2,630,000 stock options at an exercise price of $0.08 and 1,115,464 deferred share units to directors, officers, employees, and consultants. The company also announced it was named co-winner of the Canada Growth Cup and grew its total charging ports by over 45% through the acquisition of Eddie from AXSO, adding over 2,700 ports under management.
